interface.shortDescription: Run Codex-native CCG with configurable role providers and local quality gates
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native CCG fork where frontend, backend, search, and product-manager independently select registered providers through unified routing. Codex owns orchestration, implementation, and verification. External intelligence remains opt-in, Claude may run only as an explicitly selected isolated read-only product-manager Provider, and GPT Pro uses the installed Codex Desktop sidebar Skill for automated read-only evidence. Includes bounded provider evidence, hardened snapshots, Git/context helpers, spec and team workflows, and local quality/security gates.
